description:
Delete repository validation's checks of `claims.index.json`, a file the tracker no longer writes, together with the index type they read.

## Background

Repository validation checks the machine-local claims index for schema errors and duplicate leases (`crates/jit/src/validation/repository.rs:248,536-550`, through `validate_claims_index_at` and `validate_claims_index_with_paths` at `commands/validate.rs:2726-2770`, re-exported at `commands/mod.rs:98`). Lease state is stored one file per issue, so a duplicate lease cannot exist and a malformed lease record fails at its own read. `ClaimsIndex` (`storage/claim_coordinator.rs:166-262`) has no other reader. `tests/cli_item_validate/validation_lease_tests.rs:180-228` (`test_validate_repository_detects_invalid_claims_index`) asserts the check.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `validate_claims_index_at`, `validate_claims_index_with_paths`, `validate_machine_local_claims` and `ClaimsIndex` no longer exist, and repository validation reads nothing under `.git/jit/`.
- [hard] REQ-02: `test_validate_repository_detects_invalid_claims_index` no longer exists, and the remaining lease-validation tests pass.
- [hard] REQ-03: No validation-report input, and no executor code that fills one, carries claims-index problems.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: Repository validation stops checking the claims index
